<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align:justify;text-indent:-18.0pt;
mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none"><span style="font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
mso-hansi-theme-font:minor-latin">&nbsp; &nbsp; The proposed ground floor rear extension, in
conjunction with the existing ground floor rear extension and two storey rear
extension, by reason of their cumulative excessive bulk and massing would result in an unduly obtrusive, disproportionate and incongruous addition, creating an addition that would poorly relate to the original
host property and the surrounding area, and would represent an overdevelopment of the host property. The ground
floor rear extension would thereby unacceptably harm the character of the original
dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the area, contrary to the high
quality design aspirations set out in The National Planning Policy Framework
(2024), policies D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS1.B on
the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Local
Plans Policies (2013) and the Supplementary Planning Document: Residential
Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Erection of a single storey side extension, conversion of garage into habitable space and erection of a single storey rear extension
